title: The Pronoun "en"
description: Replacing de + thing, partitives and quantities.

items.translation: Replaces de + a thing or an idea (parler de, avoir besoin de, revenir de…)
items.exampleFr: Tu parles de ce film ? — Oui, j'en parle.
items.exampleEn: Are you talking about that film? — Yes, I am talking about it.

items.translation: Replaces a noun with a partitive or indefinite article
items.exampleFr: Tu veux du café ? — Oui, j'en veux.
items.exampleEn: Do you want some coffee? — Yes, I want some.

items.translation: The quantity stays after the verb
items.exampleFr: Tu as des frères ? — Oui, j'en ai deux.
items.exampleEn: Do you have brothers? — Yes, I have two.
